experiment_proposal_10.1_problem: C-line runtime and format patches exist only in isolated archive-derived trees. There is no reviewable independent git branch, and existing metadata does not record the live repo remote/branch/commit. Integration cannot proceed to source-controlled review without transferring already-frozen diffs.
experiment_proposal_10.2_existing_evidence: R40/R46 isolated diffs and SHAs; v2.4 archive member SHAs verified against R40 gold. Remote URL https://github.com/dehai168/ax630c-plate-face-demo found by parent search; ref/commit still pending. Handoff package at C/HANDOFF/ copies original patch bytes. Live checkout was not investigated.
experiment_proposal_10.3_technical_hypothesis: The frozen isolated diffs apply cleanly onto the v2.4 archive source identity. If CloudAgent finds the live repository commit matches that archive, the same diffs can be committed on a new non-production branch without changing behavior beyond what R40+R46 already measured.
experiment_proposal_10.4_why_it_may_work: This is transfer of already-built and already-tested derived sources into version control, not a new algorithm, threshold, or model. R40 and R46 already compiled and executed the derived trees in isolation.
experiment_proposal_10.5_difference_from_historical_failures: Not a new quantization or training run; not a rerun of 176/32/54/R50; not a board write; not a claim that color5 NPU or video will pass; not a production merge; not relaxing format gates or inventing legal labels.
experiment_proposal_10.6_dataset: None. Source and diffs only. No val/held/user50/GT, no protected images, no new synthetics, no models in the branch.
experiment_proposal_10.7_expected_improvement: A named independent branch and commit whose file hashes match the isolated derived sources, enabling later review and (only after product approval) controlled integration. No accuracy metric is expected to change in this step.
experiment_proposal_10.8_possible_degradation: If the live repo diverges from the archive, a forced apply could silently drop or conflict production changes. Mitigation: stop on divergence; never modify the production checkout or deployed v2.4. Format-guard call counts already change for newly legal/illegal special strings; that change must remain visible, not be hidden.
experiment_proposal_10.9_time_and_memory_budget: CloudAgent: short identity + apply + commit. Follow-up box static QA only: CPU<=2, RSS<=2GiB, 15 minutes, hash/diff only, no compile or inference.
experiment_proposal_10.10_success_fail_stop: Success: independent branch created; expected files only; hashes match isolated R40+R46 derived sources; v2.4 production artifacts and the live production checkout remain unmodified; no model run. Fail: patch does not apply, hashes diverge, or unexpected files change. Early stop: production overwrite risk, secrets in git remotes/config that must not be copied into reports, or inability to establish repo identity. Do not invent additional code fixes in this step.
